data_status: complete — FY2025 figures from FY2025 audited consolidated financial statements (filed on SEDAR+/EDGAR; 40-F/A filed Apr 2, 2026) and the Mar 30, 2026 full-year 2025 results/2026 guidance news release. Full FY2025 MD&A PDF was not individually obtained; operational detail sourced from the results release.

mines.mine_notes: Idaho's Silver Valley. Americas acquired 100% in Dec 2024 (Eric Sprott transaction; Sprott became largest shareholder); America's largest antimony mine. 20 days of planned 2025 shutdowns for No. 3 Shaft / Coeur Shaft upgrades; Phase II of No. 3 Shaft upgrade on track for 2Q 2026 (~105 stph hoisting capacity). FY2025: lead 7.5 Mlb (25% decrease vs 10.0 Mlb in 2024). 51/49 antimony JV with U.S. Antimony signed Feb 2026 to build antimony processing hub at Galena. Crescent Silver Mine (fully permitted, past-producing; 9 miles from Galena) acquired Dec 2025.

Sinaloa, Mexico (includes EC120 silver-copper orebody). Record production of ~1.2 Moz Ag in 2025 (+44% vs 2024). EC120 pre-production of 1.0 Moz Ag in 2025 (1.2 Moz project-to-date); EC120 silver-copper concentrate pre-production sales contributed ~$45M revenue ($39.5M silver + $8.5M copper net of treatment). Commercial production at EC120 declared effective Jan 1, 2026. Zinc/lead production lower in 2025 (focus shifted to EC120 ore).

notes: FY ended Dec 31, 2025; all figures USD. Consolidated attributable silver production 2.65 Moz in 2025 (+52% vs ~1.7 Moz in 2024); ~2.0 Mlb copper. EC120 pre-production contributed 1.0 Moz Ag. Total 2025 revenue $117.9M ($83.0M gross revenue incl. silver $62.2M, zinc $12.0M, lead $8.3M, other byproducts $0.4M; plus $44.8M proceeds before intended use from EC120; less $9.9M treatment/selling). 2026 guidance: 3.2–3.6 Moz Ag at AISC $30–35/oz. Audit report on 40-F carries a going-concern qualification. Registered office: 145 King Street West, Suite 2870, Toronto ON M5H 1J8.
